Android source adds a Broker activation coordinator that sequences publisher signature verification, Broker-private weights staging, Local AI load/receipt/status verification, then active-profile commit; it attempts to reload the previous model if commit fails after a successful load. PlatformStore blocks a model switch during active work or a recent plan reservation, and Zema submission shares a process lock with activation. Core JVM tests pass 46/46; API v4 clean source overlay and 23 upstream Jest tests, lint/type checks pass. `npm run verify` passes 530 Node tests, 19 Fashion tests, 301 API assertions and build. Remaining: no user-facing model catalogue/activation endpoint or production artifact source, publisher trust keyset, tokenizer/template/licence pipeline; Android automation/AIDL source is uncompiled because Android SDK platform/build-tools are unavailable. Next implement a signed-catalog install entry only after defining the operator-controlled trust/source configuration, then compile and run Binder/profile-swap/offline inference on Android CI and Pixel 10.
